# opnsense_nginx_custom_policy (Resource)

nginx NAXSI WAF policys (**Services ▸ Nginx ▸ Configuration ▸ HTTP(S) ▸ Naxsi WAF Policy**, plugin `os-nginx`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_nginx_custom_policy" "sqli" {
  name        = "sqli"
  naxsi_rules = [opnsense_nginx_naxsi_rule.sql_union.id]
  operator    = ">="
  value       = 8
  action      = "BLOCK"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name.
- `naxsi_rules` (Set of String) Rules.
- `value` (Number) If the sum of scores of all matching rules exceed the configured value the policy's action will get triggered.

### Optional

- `action` (String) Action. One of `BLOCK`, `ALLOW`, `DROP`, `LOG`. Defaults to `BLOCK`.
- `operator` (String) Operator. One of `>=`, `>`, `<`, `<=`. Defaults to `>=`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the nginx NAXSI WAF policy.
